estimate.note: run stopped early: tasks were run roughly in prefix order, so this extrapolation is BIASED; use --task-sample for an unbiased estimate

counts.note: stopped early: all counts are lower bounds for the space searched (tasksDone/tasks)

posterior.note: LM prior (10^wordLogp) renormalised over all scored fits (score bound >= tlow); unscored fits add at most unscoredMassBound relative mass

unscoredSample.note: systematic sample (every k-th unscored string scored exactly); estimated total mass of the unscored fits relative to the scored mass
